Ămestrătus , i, f.,
I.a town on the north coast of Sicily, mentioned only by Cic. and Steph. B., now Mistretta, is prob. the same place as the Amastra of Sil. 14, 267; Cic. Verr. 3, 39, 43; Steph. B. s. v.—Hence, Ămestrătīni , ōrum, m., the inhabitants of Amestratus, Cic. Verr. 3, 39, 89.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
